items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Baby Dog. Baby Dog. Baby Dog. I don't think I see any Baby Dog. No, they don't come out no more. You see a few of them. You see about five or six of them sometime on the count of the mass. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.

ctx.x: No, they don't call them. Baby Dog.
Baby Dog. Baby Dog. Baby Dog. I don't think I see any Baby Dog. No, they don't come out no more. You see a few of them. You see about five or six of them sometime on the count of the mass.
